environment.comparison_class: matched corrected full PPARG production workflow

method: A corrected full paired-end bulk production workflow with integrated output processing was compared against the matched external-tool route on the same archived input and requested output surface. The reported comparison uses the current defensible full workflow rather than earlier warm-cache pilot figures.
limitations: The evidence is one observed matched production comparison, not a replicated benchmark distribution.
Earlier 2.1-fold and 2.4-fold warm-cache pilot observations are intentionally excluded from the headline result.
Performance depends on storage state, reference layout, tool versions, and requested output composition.
